verdict.what: a small dark modern cafe or bar pavilion with a wide cantilevered roof
verdict.style: modern minimalist, dark-walled, with a leafy street-side terrace
verdict.looks: A single-storey box with near-black walls (blackstone or similar) and a stepped dark roof slab that overhangs the front and right sides on a band of brown wood planks. Under the overhang there are glass-paned windows, a dark wooden double door with a stone-brick surround, and a stair of stone steps up to a raised grey stone-brick plinth. Lanterns hang on the front and side. There is a row of leafy green bushes and vines along the terrace edge, a small wooden stool-and-table set, and an orange accent block by the entrance. The back is a plain black wall with a grey stone-brick base. Materials are crisp and uniform; the bushes and lanterns are placed on purpose.
verdict.summary: A clean, well-dressed black cafe with a strong cantilevered roof and a lively terrace, but the roof slab reads a bit like a lid and the big black walls are almost one flat material, so it needs some relief or a second material to lift the facades.
